tools.name: list_zones
tools.description: List the 25 electricity grid zones GridHub covers, with id, name, data source (EIA, ENTSO-E, NESO, AEMO), timezone, currency, licence and required attribution. Free, no credentials needed. Call this first if you are unsure which zone id to use.

tools.name: get_status
tools.description: Ingestion health per source and zone: last successful fetch timestamp and last error, if any. Free. Use it to explain stale or missing values before drawing conclusions from them.

tools.name: get_latest
tools.description: The most recent value of every metric one zone publishes (price and demand for every zone; generation by fuel for GB and US-CAISO; carbon intensity for GB; interchange where available), each with unit and timestamp. This is the right tool for 'what is the price/demand/carbon intensity in X right now

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Time series for one metric in one zone over a start/end window (Unix seconds). Rows are returned oldest-first and the 'limit' truncates from the OLDEST end, so a small limit over a wide window returns old data, not recent data — for 'the latest N points' set start close to now, or use get_latest / g

tools.name: get_map_snapshot
tools.description: Current headline values for all 25 zones in one call — the cheapest way to compare zones (e.g. 'which European zone has the lowest price right now', 'rank US ISOs by demand'). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_latest, get_zone_brief, get_history, get_map_snapshot · Private data: list_zones, get_latest, get_zone_brief, get_history, get_map_snapshot · Public sink: get_latest, get_zone_brief, get_history, get_map_snapshot · Destructive: get_latest, get_zone_brief, get_history, get_map_snapshot.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_latest, get_zone_brief, get_history, get_map_snapshot · Private data: list_zones, get_latest, get_zone_brief, get_history, get_map_snapshot · Public sink: get_latest, get_zone_brief, get_history, get_map_snapshot · Destructive: get_latest, get_zone_brief, get_history, get_map_snapshot

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
